name: Loveday
reason: A locality; the visitable thing is the Loveday Internment Collection (SATC Barmera page), which is its own place. Internment camp site itself has little to see.

name: Loxton
reason: Riverland town with Loxton Historical Village, Tree of Knowledge, silo art and Lions Park listed by SATC; several things to do.

name: Mallee Estate Winery
reason: Winery experience / cellar door: a business, not a distinct place.

name: Mannum
reason: Birthplace of Murray paddlesteamers; SATC place page: paddle steamers, riverbank pubs, dock museum, waterfall.

name: Mannum Dock Discovery Centre
reason: SATC attraction (museum and PS Marion, interactive centre), free; a museum visit of 30+ min.

name: Mannum Golf Club
reason: Local golf club facility; not a visitor draw.

name: Mannum Waterfalls
reason: SATC attraction with carpark, picnic area, free; second-tier stop. Objection: small seasonal flow, short visit.

name: Martin Bend Wetland and Walking Trail
reason: SATC Riverland attraction: wetland walking trail at Berri with carpark and toilets.

name: Meningie
reason: Wikivoyage page and regional tourism: lakeside town and Coorong gateway.

name: Mighty Murray Way
reason: A road-trip route, not a place; its stops are the places.

name: Monarto Conservation Park
reason: Agency page plus SATC attraction: mallee woodland with a short loop walk.

name: Monarto Safari Park
reason: Australia's largest open-range zoo; SATC attraction (obvious draw).

name: Morgan
reason: SATC lists Morgan Landseer Museum and the restored paddle steamer at the Murray's great bend; historic river port with several stops.

name: Murray Bridge
reason: Wikivoyage city page and SATC place page: river activities, gallery, trail, sights.

name: Murray Bridge Discovery Trail
reason: SATC attraction (free river trail with interpretation at Murray Bridge). Objection: modest, partly overlaps the town.

name: Murray Bridge Regional Gallery
reason: Wikivoyage and SATC list the gallery (public art gallery, visit 30+ min).

name: Murray Bridge Swimming Centre and Water Park
reason: Local public pool and water park; a municipal facility, not a destination draw.

name: Murray Princess
reason: An operator's paddlewheeler cruise (vehicle/operator, not a place); the place is Mannum.

name: Murray River National Park
reason: Agency page and SATC list it; Murray wetlands with walks and camping (Katarapko etc.).

name: Narrung
reason: Small settlement and ferry crossing; the draw is the Lake Albert loop and Raukkan, which are separate entries. Wrapper town.

name: Narrung and Lake Albert Scenic Loop Drive
reason: For: SATC attraction page with carpark, picnic area, toilets, free; loop includes ferry and Raukkan. Against: a drive, not a single place, and its stops are Raukkan/Narrung; vehicle-route rule.

name: Ngaut Ngaut Conservation Park
reason: Agency and SATC: Aboriginal heritage site (Devon Downs rock shelter) with guided tours; free.

name: Old Tailem Town
reason: SATC attraction: large pioneer village museum, hours-long visit.

name: Olivewood Historic Homestead and Museum
reason: Wikivoyage See listing (Chaffey's house, open Thu-Mon) and SATC.

name: Overland Corner Hotel
reason: Wikivoyage lists it under Eat as a pub with meals; a hotel/restaurant, not a sight. Searched Wikivoyage Murray and Mallee Riverland.

name: Pinnaroo
reason: Mallee town whose sources name only the Mallee Tourist and Heritage Centre; attraction, not the town, would be the spot (not listed here). Wrapper town.

name: Pooginook Conservation Park
reason: Agency page: bird watching and a 4WD-access campground, no named walk or lookout and no bushwalking information; a camping reserve.

name: Possum Parade
reason: SATC Riverland attraction: free nightly possum feeding on the Renmark riverfront, a permanent daily experience (not an event). Objection: dusk-only, short.

name: PW Mayflower
reason: Operator cruise on a paddle wheeler (vehicle); place is Mannum / dock museum.

name: Raukkan
reason: Ngarrindjeri community with the church on the $50 note and David Unaipon museum, named by regional tourism and SATC.

name: Renmark
reason: Wikivoyage and SATC: largest Riverland town, cliffs, wetlands, Olivewood, paddlesteamer, riverfront.

name: Renmark Paringa Community Museum
reason: Wikivoyage See listing and SATC: local history museum (limited hours Mon/Wed/Fri). Objection: small.

name: Swan Reach
reason: Town wrapper; its attractions (Swan Reach and District Museum, Swan Reach Observatory, Swan Reach Conservation Park) are listed separately by SATC.

name: Tailem Bend
reason: SATC place page: rail museum and info station, historic rail trail, motorsport park, river; more than one draw.

name: The 777 Motor Sport Touring Route
reason: A touring route linking venues, not a place.

name: The Big Orange
reason: Quirky roadside icon at Berri, SATC attraction (Big Thing).

name: Tintinara
reason: Town whose source names only a craft and produce stop (Heart of the Parks): a shop. Wrapper.

name: Twenty Third Street Distillery
reason: Distillery/bar: a business (Wikivoyage lists under Drink).

name: Waikerie
reason: SATC and Wikivoyage: clifftop town with silo art, street art, Rotary Clifftop Walk, riverfront.

name: Waikerie War Memorial Gardens
reason: Minor memorial garden.
